verdict.rationale: Shopify publishes multiple official MCP servers (Storefront MCP, Cart MCP, Checkout MCP, Order MCP, Catalog MCP) explicitly for connecting AI agents to real-time commerce data, with dedicated docs pages for each and a UCP framework for agentic commerce. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these MCP servers work as documented and details on setup/auth flow for external agent clients.
